remarks: Welcome to your perfect rental in the perfect location! This end-unit townhouse checks off every box on your list and then some. As you step inside, gleaming hardwood floors usher you into a sunlit and cheerful living space. The kitchen is a culinary enthusiast's delight, featuring modern stainless steel appliances and granite counters. Plus, the adjacent balcony off the dining room is ideal for enjoying morning coffee or evening unwind. The spacious living room and a convenient half bath round out this well-appointed main level. Venture upstairs to discover two inviting bedrooms with brand new hardwood floors, including the luxurious primary suite with its own private bath. Additionally, a full hall bath ensures comfort and convenience for all. But that's not all! The third floor presents a versatile space, perfect for a third bedroom. Coveted location! This townhome is just moments away from an array of top-notch eateries, boutique shops, a bustling mall, major highways for easy commuting, the nearby train station, vibrant SoNo district, and an ideal hub for hospital access. This gem won't be available for long, so don't miss out on this incredible opportunity!
